entities.name: A One-Room Hut
entities.description: Rough plank walls, a dirt floor, the smell of old woodsmoke. A cold hearth waits against one wall. Through the doorway, the yard.

entities.name: The Yard
entities.description: Long grass, wet with evening. A vegetable patch of turned soil runs along the fence; the dark shape of a well stands near the gate.

entries: [Day 1] To whoever comes next: the hearth cooks, the candle only lights. Plant early -- the potatoes take their time. There's a cat; feed it a potato if it's hungry, and it likes the fire lit. I left before the harvest. -- a hand before yours
[Day 2] Fed the cat, laid a new fire in the hearth but didn't light it — strike the flint before dark and don't let the candle burn unwatched.

[Day 3] Day 3, day: Harvested two potatoes, cooked and ate one. Hearth still burning. Cat seems content, not hungry -- didn't feed it this visit. Remember to light the candle before dark if the hearth ever goes out. -- a hand passing through
[Day 3] Fed the cat, banked the embers low but alive—add wood before dark, and mind the candle's nearly spent.
